fields.description: Detects possible DLL hijacking of wimgapi.dll by looking for suspicious image loads, loading this DLL from unexpected locations.
fields.name: Possible DLL Hijacking of wimgapi.dll
fields.query: event.type="ModuleLoad" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (module.path contains "\wimgapi.dll" and (not (module.path in ("c:\windows\system32\*","c:\windows\syswow64\*","c:\program files\Windows Kits\10\Assessment and Deployment Kit\Deployment Tools\arm64\DISM\*","c:\program files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Assessment and Deployment Kit\Deployment Tools\arm64\DISM\*")))))
